main_text.p: vesperi à vespera usque ad vesperam,& je-junamus nos & filii nostri adulti & par-vuli præter lactentes, sed Judæorum filii non jejunant,qui septimum annum non-dum attigerunt : decima autem quinta iftius mensis die solennitas est festi Taber-naculorum , quod celebratur in monte Garizim,ut prius. Facimus autem Taber-nacula,sicut dixit dominus {f} & accipi-entis vobis die primo fructum arboris pre-tiosæ, spatulas palmarum, & ramusculos arboris densæ, & salices torrentis , diesqve illius festi octavus est festivus,eo quod fe-stum illud omnium est postremum.Quo-modo autem celebramus Pascha in Si-chem,nisi observando & custodiendo in omni civitate,in qua habitamus,purifica-tiones & ea,quæ munda sint. Separamus nos ab ea, quæ menstruo laborat tertio die & septimo , mulierque sedet in im-munditie sua septem diebus, quæ autem peperit,sedet propter masculum quadra-ginta diebus ; & propter fœminam octo-ginta diebus.Circumcidimus autem præ-

page.notes: Mark (f) in the text is printed as "(f)" and is given here as {f}. The printed "Levit 23. 40." is copied as seen; the second number may be a comma. The italic passage is copied as printed. The last word of the page is continued on the catchword line "puti-". No marginal notes; the left edge carries only scan artefacts.
